# EntityAutoFade

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EntityAutoFade:Void entity:Int32, near:Float32, far:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | Entity handle. |
| `near` | In | Float32 | required | Distance where fading starts. |
| `far` | In | Float32 | required | Distance where the entity is gone. |

## Description

Makes an entity fade away with distance to the camera. Closer than `near` it is solid, farther than `far` it is invisible and between the two its alpha goes down gradually. This hides entities popping in at the far end of a scene without fog.
